consequence.statement: The tls.caOptional option configured in the ETCD provider will be ignored and no longer honored in Traefik v3.0.0.
consequence.remediation: Remove the tls.caOptional option from the ETCD provider static configuration.

original.statement: The ETCD provider's tls.caOptional configuration option has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 because TLS client authentication is a server-side option.

decision.reason: [ev-ebfb740bf1f8] says the ETCD provider `tls.CAOptional` option "has been removed in v3". Its remediation tells operators to remove `tls.caOptional` from the ETCD provider static configuration. A removed static-configuration key whose configured value is no longer honoured fits setting-ignored (action-required). The evidence does not say startup fails, so a stronger failure kind is not supported. The proposed remediation matches the evidence word for word.
